name: pixsabi
description: PixSabi - a look, think, answer picture game on Nigerian food, places, stars, slang and culture. One collage picture per puzzle, login, profiles with photos, solo play, daily puzzle, group challenges for 2 to 8 players, leaderboard. Admin page for puzzles and installable app. SQLite database. Buy coins with Paystack. Zero dependencies.
